# Agent integrations

Auto-Get-PY exposes one canonical HTTP API and mounts it under a URL alias
for every supported tool, so an agent can use the path it already expects.

| Agent | URL alias | Install |
|---|---|---|
| [Any MCP/HTTP agent](generic.md) | `/api/agent` | Point any HTTP client at http://localhost:8000/api/agent |
| [Hermes Agent](hermes.md) | `/api/hermes` | Load docs/HERMES_SKILL.md as a skill, or call /api/hermes/* directly. |
| [opencode](opencode.md) | `/api/opencode` | opencode reads `opencode.json` for the MCP server and `AGENTS.md` for instructions. Invoke the bundled subagent with `@scraper`. |
| [DeepSeek Harness (dsh / dsh-tui)](dsh.md) | `/api/dsh` | Copy `.dsh/skills/auto-get-py` into your dsh skills directory, or register `.dsh/mcp.json` with `dsh mcp add`. |
| [OpenAI Codex CLI](codex.md) | `/api/codex` | Codex reads AGENTS.md automatically. Append the `[mcp_servers.auto_get_py]` block from `.codex/config.toml` to `~/.codex/config.toml` to expose the tools. |
| [Claude Code](claude.md) | `/api/claude` | Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md and `.mcp.json`, and loads the skill from `.claude/skills/auto-get-py/SKILL.md`. |
| [Gemini CLI](gemini.md) | `/api/gemini` | Gemini CLI reads GEMINI.md and `.gemini/settings.json`. |
| [Cursor](cursor.md) | `/api/cursor` | Cursor loads `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` and `.cursor/mcp.json`. |
| [GitHub Copilot](copilot.md) | `/api/copilot` | Repository instructions and `.vscode/mcp.json` are read automatically by VS Code / Copilot. |
| [Cline](cline.md) | `/api/cline` | Cline reads `.clinerules/` from the workspace root. |
| [Roo Code](roo.md) | `/api/roo` | Roo Code reads `.roo/rules/` and `.roo/mcp.json`. |
| [Windsurf](windsurf.md) | `/api/windsurf` | Windsurf reads `.windsurf/rules/` automatically. |
| [Continue](continue.md) | `/api/continue` | Continue loads rules from `.continue/rules/`. |
| [Aider](aider.md) | `/api/aider` | Run `aider --read CONVENTIONS.md`, or rely on `.aider.conf.yml`. |
| [Zed](zed.md) | `/api/zed` | Zed reads `.rules` for its agent panel and `.zed/settings.json` for context servers. |
| [Amp](amp.md) | `/api/amp` | Amp reads AGENTS.md from the repository root. |
| [Jules](jules.md) | `/api/jules` | Jules reads AGENTS.md from the repository root. |

## The canonical API

## Quick reference

| Task | Call |
|---|---|
| Is it running? | `curl http://localhost:8000/api/health` |
| What exists on a page? | `POST /api/agent/quick` with `{"url": "…", "crawl_depth": 2}` |
| Download it all | `POST /api/agent/scrape` with `{"url": "…", "wait": true}` |
| Render a JS page and download | `POST /api/agent/direct` with `{"url": "…"}` |
| One exact file | `POST /api/agent/fetch` with `{"url": "…"}` |
| Progress | `GET /api/agent/status/{id}` |
| Final files | `GET /api/agent/results/{id}` |
| Stop it | `POST /api/agent/cancel/{id}` |

Prefer the MCP tools (`scrape`, `quick_scrape`, `fetch_file`, `task_status`,
`task_results`, `cancel_task`, `list_files`) when your client supports MCP —
they wrap the same endpoints with better descriptions.
